title: calacinum peruvianum
intro: Calacinum peruvianum, commonly known as Peruvian maca, is a plant native to the Andean region of Peru, belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include improving fertility, reducing symptoms of menopause, and increasing energy levels. The therapeutic actions of Peruvian maca are attributed to its ability to adaptogenic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to balance the body's hormonal and endocrine systems. The bioactive constituents of Calacinum peruvianum include alkaloids, glycosides, and sterols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
